text:
tara_ops: Quick update — we just published the new maintainers-handbook v1.0.0 to the community repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/maintainers-handbook/releases/tag/v1.0.0 :tada:

release-bot: Release created: maintainers-handbook v1.0.0 by @tara_ops — changelog + checklist included — https://github.com/redwood-inference/maintainers-handbook/releases/tag/v1.0.0

devon_m: awesome! any guidance on backport policies? we still have a couple of patch branches in redwoodctl that need maintainer guidance.

tara_ops: devon_m yes — section 3 covers backport criteria and the triage flow. TL;DR: security/hotfix -> patch branch, otherwise prefer patch-on-master + cherrypick PR notes.

maria_g: thanks — can we add a short README copy for localization teams? want to kick off translations for the onboarding checklists.

tara_ops: good call. I'll add a localization subsection this week and tag @olivia_support for community docs help.

olivia_support: happy to help — we can run a localization sprint next Tue. i'll post the details in #community-docs and ping translators.

ben_engineering: tiny nit: the release notes mention "expected maintainer hours" — is that per-incident or per-week?

tara_ops: per-month estimate; i'll clarify in the notes (and add a short FAQ).

release-bot: Asset uploaded: maintainers-handbook-v1.0.0.pdf (sha256: 3f4b9a...) — signed and archived.

devon_m: sweet. also, can we get a short blurb for the website / community newsletter? i'll draft if someone approves.

tara_ops: please do draft, devon_m — CC: @maria_g for localization and @olivia_support for publishing.

maria_g: i'll translate the newsletter blurb into en/es/fr and drop copies in #community-announce for review.

olivia_support: quick ops note — maintainers-handbook includes the new on-call rotation template. if teams want to opt-in, reply here and we'll run the opt-in script. :white_check_mark:

ben_engineering: opting in for eng-runtime.

devon_m: opting in for eng-platform.

tara_ops: thanks all — super quick release, but covers a lot of small process gaps we've seen. If you find anything missing, open an issue in the repo and tag 'maintainers' label. :sparkles:

release-bot: Thread archived to announcements channel.
